layer.Description: Read-out layer, 1-7 (index + 1 along the first axis of array layer_means_resp_face_cos_f_n); 7 is the layer used in the main analyses.

r2.Description: Single-feature predictivity of that layer's face/no-face distance. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY).
